recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current source satisfies the published FHIR-22855 resolution; a future CDA/DICOM/v2 worked example would be editorial enrichment rather than a required conformance correction for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-22855 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for ExampleScenario. It asked to support ExampleScenario instances that represent non-FHIR standards by no longer binding instance.resourceType as a required FHIR resource type; the approved modification was to use Coding, loosen the binding to extensible, include HL7 v2 message structures, and clarify that the value identifies an exchanged data instance or structure rather than only a FHIR resource.
initial_application: The 2022 ExampleScenario cleanup history applied the request across multiple commits. Commit 2f6dfcd introduced the examplescenario-instance-type value set with FHIR resource types plus HL7 v2 table 0354 and changed the former field from code to Coding. Commit 022f97b renamed the field to structureType and loosened its binding to extensible. Commit de7f583 explicitly recorded the remaining FHIR-37195, FHIR-22855, FHIR-25260, and FHIR-37895 ExampleScenario work.
additional_context: ExampleScenario is active in source/fhir.ini, and current fhir.ini migration mappings redirect old ExampleScenario.instance.resourceType references to ExampleScenario.instance.structureType. Related cleanup issues FHIR-37195, FHIR-25260, and FHIR-37895 are already represented on the combined branch. FHIR-I minutes from 2019-12-02 confirm the FHIR-22855 disposition, and targeted Zulip searches found no direct conflicting FHIR-22855 discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scoped StructureDefinition defines ExampleScenario.instance.structureType as Coding with an extensible binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/examplescenario-instance-type, and that value set includes FHIR resource types plus HL7 v2 message structures. The element definition and structureVersion rule distinguish FHIR from non-FHIR structures without preventing external Coding values.
